title: RESOLVED — 51 of 70 Pakistan gas rows are ONE July-2023 bulk load off two MAP files; SNGPL's own asset register now accounts for 49 of them
summary: 73% of GEM's Pakistan gas rows (51 of 70) were loaded in one 5-day window in July 2023 off two CARTOGRAPHIC sources (an SNGPL JPG transmission map + a PEPL PDF energy map), which is why 362 ref units came back UNRESOLVED and why 16 rows were flagged 'existence' — the flag was tracking SEGMENT OBSCURITY, not doubt about existence. DO NOT delete rows off those flags. RESOLVED 2026-08-10: the primary source the memo asked for turned out to exist and be live — SNGPL Annual Report 2018, 'TRANSMISSION SYSTEM As at June 30, 2018' (pp.32-37), a 270-row text-searchable inventory of every transmission section with diameter and mainline/loopline km. It matches 49 of the 51-row cohort at the register's own two-decimal precision (45 single-section matches + 4 exact arithmetic composites where GEM aggregates and the register itemises). CONSEQUENCES FOR THIS PACKET: (1) ALL FIVE residual existence questions are CONFIRMED EXISTING (P4089, P4106, P4137, P4141, P4177 are each a named register line matching on length AND diameter). (2) ALL THREE redundancy clusters resolve as NOT duplicates — the register lists both pipes separately at DIFFERENT diameters, the ordinary mainline/loopline pattern (P4105 vs P4099+P4100; P4079 vs P4101; P4181 and P4179). (3) 98 ref-only units across 49 rows are staged in staging/register-crosswalk/ — Length [ref] and Diameter [ref] were EMPTY on every one of them and the sheet VALUES are unchanged, so this is pure ref work. (4) Only TWO items remain: P4074 (register says 52.23 km vs the sheet's 55.23 — the ONLY numeric disagreement across 49 matched rows, so likely a one-digit slip) and P5486 Mardan-Swat (the ONE row the register does not account for at all — now a much sharper signal than before). NOT fixed by the register: the 8 SSGC rows have no equivalent document yet, and the register carries NO commissioning years, so the 60 operating-with-no-StartYear1 rows are untouched by it. Extraction control: the parse reconciles to the register's printed grand total, 4,685.92 / 4,190.05 km.

title: RESOLVED — the gem.wiki Cloudflare block was solved and both wiki legs were re-run (the packet carries the REAL wiki findings)
summary: The 403 that blinded this pass is fixed: gem.wiki's WAF passes a request whose User-Agent leads with the 'baird-wiki' token, so url_verifier.py / wiki_alignment.py / harvest_wiki_citations.py now share one WIKI_UA constant and get HTTP 200. Both legs were re-run on 2026-08-10 and the packet you are holding carries the results, not the blank ones. Wiki alignment went from 70 all-UNPARSED to 99 real records over 70 rows (69 SHEET_SUSPECT / 24 WIKI_UPDATE / 6 WIKI_STALE_VS_STAGED, zero UNPARSED); the citation harvest went from 0 to 63/63 pages and 231 citations. What the blackout actually cost: almost nothing on the refs side — those 63 pages contain only 10 distinct external URLs between them, which is what a map-bulk-load country looks like (it did surface three new leads: an SSGC capacity PDF, an SSGC downloads page, and a 03/2023 SNGPL transmission map newer than the 04/2022 map every row cites). It cost real findings on the alignment side — 31 substantive ones the packet would otherwise never have shown, plus 68 of one systemic kind (see the Operator entry below). The earlier warning is now obsolete: an empty WikiUpdates surface no longer means 'could not read'.

title: READ FIRST on the wiki tab — 68 of the 99 wiki records are ONE question (blank Operator), and it is not a Pakistan defect
summary: 68 of the 69 SHEET_SUSPECT wiki-alignment records are the same field: Operator is blank on the operators/owners tab while the wiki page displays one. Do NOT work these as 68 flags. A blank Operator is the GGIT norm — the column is filled on just 1,464 of 6,462 rows tracker-wide (22.7%) — so Pakistan at 0 of 70 is unusual only in being complete, while Owner1 is filled on 70 of 70. There is ONE decision: should Pakistan's Operator column be populated at all? If yes it is a bulk edit, not research — 52 rows SNGPL, 12 rows SSGC (operator = owner in a two-company system), with only the 6 transnational/proposed rows (Iran MoP x2, Turkmengaz, Government of Pakistan, Interstate Gas Systems, Gazprom) needing individual judgement. Two constraints: the wiki value is the lead and never the ref (the SNGPL register already staged in staging/register-crosswalk/ is the citable source for the SNGPL cohort), and Operator + Operator [ref] must land together. The other 31 records are the real content and are worth reading properly.

title: Deep-sweep fills were staged as value changes when they are ref-only work (fixed)
summary: ~83% of deep-sweep fills[] output across 7 countries proposes the value ALREADY on the sheet - it is ref attachment to a MISSING_REF cell, not a value change - but the merge staged every one as class_in=FILL, which tints the value cell on the paste surface as a proposed value. Fixed in merge_qc.is_ref_only + merge_deepsweep_shards: such fills now upgrade their ref record (colored [ref], untinted value). Pakistan is built on the fix, so its AllFillsBackend tints ONLY genuine changes. The 7 already-delivered countries (Libya 82/87, Saudi ref-sweep-critical 117/141, Egypt, Iran, Iraq, China-Guangxi) still carry the old rendering; regenerating them is Baird's call - two are partially applied.

title: ShelvedCancelledType/DelayType vocabulary was wrong in our docs and code (fixed)
summary: Our reference docs, CLAUDE.md, the subagent contract and merge_qc all specified Title-Case 'Presumed'/'Confirmed' for ShelvedCancelledType and DelayType. The live columns hold lowercase 'inferred'/'confirmed' - 'Presumed' appears ZERO times in either tracker, and it is a different word, not a casing slip. build_qc_workbook's vocab check was inverted end to end: it would have flagged all 282 real ShelvedCancelledType rows and all 330 DelayType rows as violations while passing our own bad values. All fixed; Pakistan re-merged (P0452 -> confirmed, P3173/P3174 -> inferred). NOTE: 15 staged records in china-guangxi/iraq/egypt/iran still read 'Presumed' - if you paste a shelved/cancelled row from one of those packets, type 'inferred'.
